name: Ligaya Mishan
role: Co-chief restaurant critic (appointed June 2025)
beat: NYC-focused restaurant criticism, with some national reach
note: NYT dropped critic anonymity with this appointment, so her identity is public; NYT also adds brief starred reviews from other writers.

name: Tejal Rao
role: Co-chief restaurant critic (appointed June 2025)
beat: Nationwide restaurant criticism; California-based, travels often
note: Former NYT California critic (since 2018), James Beard award winner; no longer anonymous.

name: Matthew Schneier
role: Chief restaurant critic (took over from Adam Platt, Aug 2023)
note: Former fashion/culture writer (The Cut, NYT) turned critic; reviews run on Grub Street.

photoCredit.text: Cultured magazine interview, cross-checked with Cultured group portrait

name: Helen Rosner
role: Food correspondent / staff writer; writes the Tables for Two restaurant column (took over from Hannah Goldfield by Sept 2025)
note: Won the 2024 James Beard Craig Claiborne Distinguished Criticism Award; ex-Eater and Saveur editor.

name: Hannah Goldfield
role: Staff writer; former Tables for Two critic (first full-time New Yorker restaurant critic, 2018)
note: Stepped down from the Tables for Two column; Helen Rosner now writes it. Exact step-down date not verified.

name: Gwendal Poullennec
role: International Director of the MICHELIN Guides
beat: Oversees all Guide selections worldwide, including North America
note: The Guide's public face; inspectors themselves are anonymous. 2026 Northeast Cities ceremony (incl. NYC) is Dec 14 at the Glasshouse, Manhattan.

name: Michelin Guide inspectors (anonymous)
role: Full-time inspectors (identities not public)
note: Book under assumed names and pay in full; cannot be identified by face or name. Treat every table equally.

name: Elazar Sontag
role: Food critic (started Nov 2025)
beat: National-profile critic based in DC; former Bon Appetit restaurant editor
note: Publicly shows his face and restored star ratings; still avoids reserving under his own name. Could visit NYC.

name: Pete Wells
role: Reporter covering food (former chief restaurant critic, 2012 to Aug 2024)
note: Kept his face out of print for his whole run as critic, so there is no reliable photo. Booked under fake names.

name: Florence Fabricant
role: Food and wine writer; Off the Menu column on new openings
beat: New restaurant openings and food news
note: Her Off the Menu column is where NYC openings get announced.

name: Eric Asimov
role: Chief wine critic
note: Likely to notice the wine program as much as the food.

name: Priya Krishna
role: Food staff reporter; interim restaurant critic from July 2024
note: Filled in as critic alongside Melissa Clark after Wells. Whether she still reviews after June 2025 is unverified.

name: Sam Sifton
role: Assistant managing editor; founder of NYT Cooking, former food editor
note: Influences NYT food coverage decisions. Exact 2026 portfolio unverified.

name: Ryan Sutton
role: Chief critic and editor; formerly Eater NY chief critic (position eliminated)
note: Longtime star-rating-style critic; now self-published, so he may dine on his own account.

name: Robert Sietsema
role: Independent writer; laid off from Eater Dec 2024, started Substack in 2025
beat: Cheap eats and neighborhood NYC dining
note: Decades-long NYC dining chronicler (ex-Village Voice, Eater) who writes about LES-type neighborhood places.

name: Stephanie Wu
role: Editor-in-chief (since March 2022); Eater now owned by PMX / Penske Media
note: Eater cut 15 staff in Aug 2025 incl. Northeast deputy editor Erika Adams; current Eater NY editor could not be verified.

name: Clare Reichenbach
role: Chief executive officer
beat: Runs the JBF Awards, JBF House and programs
note: Her organization names the Restaurant & Chef Awards (Rising Star, Best New Restaurant), which iara is eligible for after opening.

name: Jamila Robinson
role: Editor-in-chief (since Sept 2023)
beat: Leads both titles; Bon Appetit publishes the Best New Restaurants list
note: Former Philadelphia Inquirer food editor and ex-JBF journalism chair.

name: Hunter Lewis
role: Editor-in-chief (since 2017)
beat: Leads F&W, incl. Best New Chefs
note: Runs the Best New Chefs program.

name: Morgan Carter
role: Food and Drink Editor (announced July 2024)
note: Ex-Denver food writer; leads Time Out NY's restaurant coverage.

name: Steve Cuozzo
role: Restaurant critic, real estate columnist (per Wikipedia, which lists him as living)
note: Veteran tabloid critic known for harsh pans. Whether he still reviews in 2026 is unverified. Still publishing at the Post as of Sept 2026.

name: Tom Sietsema
outlet: NOTUS / Next Course newsletter (formerly The Washington Post)
role: Food correspondent at NOTUS; retired as WaPo critic Oct 2025
note: 25 years as the Post's critic; famous for disguises and anonymity (now retired from that role).

name: Adam Platt
role: Former chief restaurant critic (22 years, to 2023); NYU journalism faculty
note: Reviewed NYC for New York magazine for 22 years before Matthew Schneier took over; not currently reviewing.

name: Ruth Reichl
outlet: Former NYT chief critic; Gourmet editor
role: Author and Substack writer; former NYT critic (1993-99) and Gourmet editor
note: Famous for wearing disguises while reviewing; still widely recognized in NYC.

name: Arthur Schwartz
outlet: Podcast (Food Maven / Food Mensch); formerly NY Daily News
role: Former NY Daily News restaurant critic and food editor; active podcaster in 2026
note: Longtime radio/podcast voice, still publishing 2026 episodes.

name: Keith Lee
role: Food reviewer, Las Vegas-based
beat: 10-point scale reviews, often takeout, favors Black- and family-owned spots
note: About 17M TikTok followers (May 2025); his visits create the 'Keith Lee effect' and he says he pays and has family pick up to avoid VIP treatment.

name: Dave Portnoy
role: Founder; pizza reviewer
note: One of the most visible NYC pizza reviewers by reach; role from general knowledge, not re-verified here.

name: David Chang
role: Chef-founder, host of a podcast
note: Industry heavyweight whose opinions travel; role from general knowledge, photo is from 2010.
